verdict.rationale: Chronicle Labs is a SaaS agent-evaluation platform, so data export and portability is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no export feature, no open export formats, and no account offboarding path. Querying events through the SDK and ingesting via an OpenTelemetry exporter are developer building blocks and inbound integrations, not a documented capability to export all of a user's data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
